title: A taken fix needs two check records to close
what: `relay check record check` accepts reviews of different reviewed shas (each finding judged against its own review), or `relay queue done` accepts a check whose Q1 verdict is in a second record of the same head.
why: Every queue fix runs take (Q1 reviewed at the take sha), then a whole-change review at a later sha; one check cannot hold both, so closing is refused until a second check is run (core-tests-not-in-gate, 23 Oct).
failing_case: A check over core-tests.json (reviewed 4522dcb, Q1) and core-tests-review.json (reviewed 54c5dca, F1-F3) is refused at lib/relay_verdict.py:550 "the review data ... is of 4522dcb..., not of the reviewed sha 54c5dca..."; the checker drops Q1 to the notes and `relay queue done` then refuses for lack of a Q1 verdict.
pass_cases: One check over a take findings file and a later whole-change review records verdicts for Q1 and F1..Fn, and `relay queue done` accepts it.
dropped_why: "a" (owner, 23 Oct, choosing: replace the three patch items with one redesign: one record per change, one reader)
